PLAN FOR THE SAW

Optimise the whole sheet.

  1. Match the material.Plywood and MDF, or different thicknesses, are planned separately.
  2. Protect the grain.Lock a part’s length to the sheet grain. Locked parts never rotate.
  3. Reduce cuts. Keep useful offcuts.Compare the whole list: place all parts, minimise sheets, then minimise cuts and preserve reusable offcuts. Input order is ignored; part priorities apply only when enabled.
